requirement_text: Programme shall track verified supplier CO2 baselines
Programme shall report decarbonisation progress quarterly
System shall migrate all legacy requirements with attributes
System shall provide a requirements traceability view
System shall export requirements to CSV
Cells shall withstand thermal propagation without external flame
Qualification evidence shall cover three production lots
Sustained yield shall exceed the agreed baseline by four points
Firmware shall meet interference limits across all channels
Release shall include a documented deviation list
Migrated supplier records shall retain original identifiers
Safety case shall address every identified hazard
Assessor findings shall be closed with recorded evidence
Automated suites shall publish results to the shared dashboard
Packaging shall reduce material mass by fifteen percent
Alternative material shall pass customer qualification
